question: What are the top 20 assets with their plaque numbers and titles, along with the date of their most recent transaction, ordered by the latest transaction date descending?
reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)     a.[PlaqueNumber],     a.[Title],     MAX(at.[ActivityDate]) AS [LastTransactionDate] FROM [AST].[Asset] AS a JOIN [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at ON at.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId] GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title] ORDER BY [LastTransactionDate] DESC
final_generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 20 a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title], MAX(at.[ActivityDate]) AS LatestTransactionDate
FROM [AST].[Asset] AS a
INNER JOIN [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at ON at.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId]
GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title]
ORDER BY LatestTransactionDate DESC

question: Show the first 20 bank accounts ordered by account number ascending, with their current balance and historical balance.
reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo],  ba.[Balance] AS CurrentBalance, bab.[Balance] AS HistoricalBalance FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba JOIN [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] AS bab ON bab.[BankAccountRef] = ba.[BankAccountId] ORDER BY ba.[AccountNo]
final_generated_sql:
SELECT TOP 20 ba.AccountNo, ba.Balance AS CurrentBalance, bab.Balance AS HistoricalBalance
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] ba
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT b1.BankAccountRef, b1.Balance
    FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] b1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT BankAccountRef, MAX(FiscalYearRef) AS MaxFiscalYear
        FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance]
        GROUP BY BankAccountRef
    ) b2 ON b1.BankAccountRef = b2.BankAccountRef AND b1.FiscalYearRef = b2.MaxFiscalYear
) bab ON ba.BankAccountId = bab.BankAccountRef
ORDER BY ba.AccountNo ASC

question: ۲۰ دارایی با بیشترین مجموع هزینه خرید را به ترتیب نزولی مجموع هزینه نمایش دهید. شماره پلاک، عنوان و مجموع هزینه خرید را برگردانید. دارایی‌های بدون آیتم رسید خرید را نیز نگه دارید؛ مجموع هزینه آن‌ها می‌تواند خالی باشد.
